title: achyronia nigra
intro: Achyronia nigra, commonly known as Black Nightshade, is a plant species in the Solanaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to aid in pain relief, reduce inflammation, and support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Achyronia nigra are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and expectorant. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include solanine, solanidine, and other glycoalkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
